rules: Smooth entrance animation on menu items and POS grid items with staggerChildren: 0.05
Tactile hover micro-interactions (scale: 1.02, translateY: -2px) on product cards and action buttons
Cart drawer badge bounce whenever a new drink item is added
Payment method tabs smooth layout transition
Active state on buttons must provide immediate visual feedback (active:scale-95)
Strict compliance with prefers-reduced-motion using conditional CSS / framer-motion variants
All buttons, inputs, cart modifiers, and date pickers must have descriptive aria-labels
Thermal receipt preview maintains strict monochrome high-contrast ratio (21:1 black on white)
Screen readers announced dynamic totals whenever cart modifiers or quantities change
Keyboard tab navigation navigable through POS terminal without trap

testing_attributes.convention: kebab-case data-testid on every interactive and key data display element

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend + Vite React 19 frontend). Ensure all backend API routes in backend/server.py or backend/routers/ are properly prefixed with /api.
Implement full Indonesian rupiah formatting (e.g. 'Rp 35.000') with Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID', { style: 'currency', currency: 'IDR', minimumFractionDigits: 0 }).

Provide three main views: 1) Marketing Landing Page (/) showcasing the artisan brand story, juice benefits, tropical fresh aesthetic, and quick jump to POS; 2) POS Terminal (/pos) optimized for cashier speed with product grid, customizable modifiers (Size Regular/Large, Ice, Sweetness, Superfood Add-ons), cart management, and payment methods (Cash with change calculation, QRIS with QR code display, Card); 3) Sales History (/history) with date-range filtering, multi-order selection, summary analytics, single receipt modal, and 80mm continuous thermal batch printing.
Thermal Receipt (@media print): Ensure 80mm receipt styling renders cleanly at width ~80mm (300px on screen), uses monospace font, and correctly supports window.print() for single and batch prints.
Pre-seed realistic Indonesian juice bar orders for today and previous days in the backend/seed.py so the history tab is immediately populated and testable.
Always degrade gracefully if the static build runs without active backend responses by providing rich local state fallback.
